dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple discrete and interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with irregular, high-contrast dark boundaries that transition abruptly to lighter interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters, appearing as small bright points along the upper dorsal edge and scattered across the posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest and most prominent macro-annuli in the central dorsal-lateral area form an obtuse scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: The texture exhibits a complex interlocking pattern where several annuli share boundaries, creating a chain-like geometric topology across the mid-lateral flank.
